annotation.kind: source selection, Doolittle execution certificate, rectangular finite-matrix encoding, and zero-based index adapter

assumptions: The matrix has dimensions m by n with m>=n and n>0.
A, LHat, and UHat belong to one finite symmetric radix format whose rounding laws implement the paper's round-to-nearest error bounds with unit roundoff u.

Gaussian elimination is represented by a completed Doolittle trace: LHat is unit lower trapezoidal, UHat is upper triangular, and every computed entry is linked to its scalar subtraction or pivot-division execution.

Every scalar execution records rounded products, an arbitrary permuted binary summation tree, range checks excluding underflow and overflow, and the protected input's path through the actual rounded merges.
A protected summation trace assumes only the earlier equation (2.4) estimate for each sibling subtree; the Lemma 4.1 residual estimates and all Doolittle local and global bounds must be derived.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P05 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P05 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p05_t2_lu_backward_error {m n : Nat} (run : P05DoolittleRun m n) : the local (4.3a)-(4.3b) bounds and exists DeltaA, LHat*UHat=A+DeltaA, |DeltaA|<=n*u*|LHat||UHat|, with the square rowwise and (n-1)u refinements
formal_statement.plain_language: Every completed range-safe rectangular Doolittle execution has the two local residual bounds and the full componentwise LU backward-error conclusion of Theorem 4.2, including both square-case sharpenings.

informal_proof: First prove the scalar Lemma 4.1 residual estimates from the protected-leaf summation trace, the equation (2.4) sibling estimates, and the format's rounding-error laws. Specialize those results to each certified upper-row and below-diagonal computation to obtain (4.3a) and (4.3b). Triangular support turns each through-pivot sum into the full entry of LHat*UHat. Set DeltaA=LHat*UHat-A. The local stage indices are at most n, giving the rectangular n*u bound; when m=n, each coefficient is at most the zero-based row index and then at most n-1.
informal_statement: Theorem 4.2 in full: rectangular LU backward stability, the local Doolittle estimates used in its proof, and the sharper rowwise and uniform square bounds.
